ISS2000 PC Port NC 1.0.1 - 9 November 2026

Changes since 1.0.0:
- Less processing work per match frame: around one third less frame parsing time on the test PC, with the same graphics quality.
- Night matches avoid the pause when a night flag is first drawn.
- Windows 11 no longer slows the game timer after you switch to another window and return.
